topicName: Water and Carbon Cycles, Hazards and Global Governance

steps.title: Carbon Sink
steps.body: A natural or artificial reservoir that absorbs and stores more carbon than it releases (e.g. tropical rainforests, oceans).

steps.title: Hazard Vulnerability
steps.body: The conditions determined by physical, social, economic, and environmental factors which increase the susceptibility of a community to hazard impacts.
